title: 第326章 我怀疑老祖已经遭遇了不测第325章 太原崔氏
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
“那换个问题。”崔文则的手指在册子上轻轻敲了敲，“以铁剑山庄的判断，真如寺这番实力，在佛门八宗里能排到什么位置？”
韩千山放下茶盏，想了想。
“栖云寺和缘起寺这两个已经被甩在后面了。
护国寺有凡净大师，有六百年的底蕴，有皇室的支持。
真如寺如果想和护国寺扳手腕，应该只是五五开。
但以真如寺这些年扩充势力的速度，超过对方的时间不会太长。”他顿了顿，“十年。最多十年。”
崔文则有些惊讶，太原崔家作为大玄王朝的原始小股东，对大玄王朝和护国寺的实力还是知道一些的。
倒是没想到铁剑山庄对真如寺评价这么高。
他脸上不动声色，端起茶壶，给韩千山续了一杯茶。
“韩兄，崔家有个孩子在真如寺，是真玄大师的嫡传弟子。明远那孩子，你应该听说过。”
韩千山点了点头。
“如远大师，化劲初期，孤裁和尚。江湖上都在传，说他是真如寺中最像真玄大师的弟子。”
“最像不敢说。”崔文则摇了摇头，但嘴角的笑意怎么都收不住，“但确实没给崔家丢脸。”
韩千山看着他，沉默了两个呼吸，忽然开口：“崔老爷，在下多嘴一句。”
“请说。”
“真如寺的崛起，是大势。崔家的孩子在真如寺，这是天大的缘分。
但这个缘分怎么用、用多少、用到什么程度，分寸很重要。”
韩千山的声音压得很低：
“在下在江湖上跑了二十年，见过太多世家把孩子送进门派，一开始关系好得跟一家人似的，后来门派壮大了，世家觉得孩子受了委屈，两边闹得不可开交。
最后孩子夹在中间，里外不是人。”

崔文则放下茶盏，看着韩千山。
“韩兄的意思是——”
“在下的意思是，真如寺已经不是六年前那个中寺了。
崔家跟真如寺的关系，也不是单纯的‘送孩子学艺’了。
如今这局面，崔家跟真如寺是绑在一起的。
真如寺强，崔家跟着强；真如寺若有什么闪失，崔家也跑不了。
既然如此，与其等着绑，不如主动绑。”
崔文则没有说话。
他端起茶盏，一口一口地喝着，茶已经凉了，但他喝得很慢。
韩千山站起身来。“崔老爷，在下告辞了。”
崔文则也站起身来，抱拳道：“韩兄慢走。崔福，送客。”
韩千山转身走出了书房，脚步声在走廊上渐行渐远。
崔文则站在窗前，望着窗外的暮色。
夕阳已经沉到了山脊后面，天边只剩最后一抹暗红。
夜风拂过，吹得桌上的纸页哗哗作响。
崔福送完客回来，站在门口。“老爷，晚饭备好了。”
崔文则没有回头，“去把东厢那坛三十年陈的女儿红搬出来，今晚我喝两杯。”
崔福应了一声，转身去了。
崔文则站在窗前，望着远处灰蒙蒙的天际。
他估摸着真如寺冲击上寺以后，明远应该已经能独当一面了。
content_en:
"Then let's change the question." Cui Wenze tapped his finger on the booklet, "Based on Iron Sword Villa's judgment, where does Zhenru Temple's strength rank among the eight sects of Buddhism?"
Han Qianshan put down the tea cup and thought for a while.
“Qiyun Temple and Yuanqi Temple have been left behind.
Huguo Temple has Master Fanjing, who has a heritage of six hundred years and has the support of the royal family.
If Zhenru Temple wants to have an arm-wrestle with Huguo Temple, it should only be a 50-50 draw.
But with the speed at which Zhenru Temple has expanded its power over the years, it won't take long for it to surpass the opponent. He paused and said, "Ten years." Ten years at most. "
Cui Wen was a little surprised. As the original minority shareholder of the Daxuan Dynasty, the Taiyuan Cui family knew a little about the strength of the Daxuan Dynasty and Huguo Temple.
I didn’t expect that Iron Sword Villa would rate Zhenru Temple so highly.
With a calm expression on his face, he picked up the teapot and refilled Han Qianshan's cup of tea.
"Brother Han, the Cui family has a child in Zhenru Temple, who is a direct disciple of Master Zhenxuan. You should have heard of that child Mingyuan."
Han Qianshan nodded.
"Master Ruyuan, a solitary monk in the early stage of transformation. There are rumors in the world that he is the disciple in Zhenru Temple who is most like Master Zhenxuan."
"Most likely I dare not say it." Cui Wenze shook his head, but he couldn't hold back the smile on his lips, "But it certainly didn't embarrass the Cui family."
Han Qianshan looked at him, was silent for two breaths, and then suddenly said: "Master Cui, please say more."
"Please tell me."
"The rise of Zhenru Temple is a general trend. It is a great fate that the children of the Cui family are in Zhenru Temple.
But how to use this fate, how much to use, and to what extent, propriety is very important. "
Han Qianshan's voice was very low:
"I have been traveling in the world for twenty years, and I have seen too many aristocratic families send their children into sects. At first, the relationship was as good as a family, but later on, as the sect grew, the aristocratic families felt that their children had been wronged, and the two sides got into trouble.
In the end, the child is caught in the middle, no longer human inside or outside. "
Cui Wenze put down the tea cup and looked at Han Qianshan.
"Brother Han means-"
“What I’m saying is that Zhenru Temple is no longer the Central Temple it was six years ago.
The relationship between the Cui family and Zhenru Temple is no longer simply about ‘sending their children to learn arts’.
In this current situation, the Cui family and Zhenru Temple are tied together.
If Zhenru Temple is strong, the Cui family will be strong; if anything happens to Zhenru Temple, the Cui family will not be able to escape.
In this case, instead of waiting to be tied, it is better to take the initiative. "
Cui Wen did not speak.
He picked up the teacup and drank sip after sip. The tea was already cold, but he drank it slowly.
Han Qianshan stood up. "Master Cui, I have to take my leave."
Cui Wenze also stood up, clasped his fists and said, "Brother Han, walk slowly. Cui Fu, see the guests off."
Han Qianshan turned around and walked out of the study, his footsteps getting farther and farther in the corridor.
Cui Wen stood in front of the window, looking out at the dusk.
The setting sun has sunk behind the ridge, leaving only the last trace of dark red on the horizon.
The night wind blew by, making the pages on the table rattle.
Cui Fu came back from seeing off the guests and stood at the door. "Sir, dinner is ready."
Cui Wenze didn't look back, "Go and bring out the 30-year-old daughter Hong from the altar in the east chamber. I'll have two drinks tonight."
Cui Fu responded and turned around.
Cui Wen stood in front of the window, looking at the gray sky in the distance.
He estimated that after Zhenru Temple attacked the upper temple, Mingyuan should be able to take charge of it on his own.
